chunks.title: Context, delta & dependency pin
chunks.summary: Inspect the four packages, write the keep/refactor/missing delta report, and pin dependency versions.
chunks.dod: Written delta + pinned versions; decision review only for latest-together conflicts.

chunks.title: Contracts & core ports
chunks.summary: The shared zod contract families and every planned core port now exist. Type-only contract coupling is mechanically linted, emitted runtime purity is tested, and contract plus port-conformance coverage is in place.
chunks.dod: Complete: boundary lint and runtime-purity tests are green; contract and port suites cover the delivered surface.

chunks.title: API security foundation, replica-set profile & env sync
chunks.summary: Fastify now issues and echoes request ids, redacts sensitive logs, returns the shared safe error envelope, resolves trusted client IPs for rate limiting, applies strict CORS, splits liveness/readiness, and enforces the cookie/CSRF foundation. The Mongo transaction manager is bound and proven against rs0.
chunks.dod: Complete: API boot and health probes, CSRF matrix, and replica-set commit/rollback proof are green.

chunks.title: Cookie-session auth, PIN, OTP & OAuth
chunks.summary: Cookie sessions, atomic refresh rotation/reuse revocation, session-bound CSRF, storefront/admin audiences, verified-before-creation signup, password and OTP login by email or phone, Google and Facebook verification adapters, identity linking, remember-me lifetime alignment, password management, account self-service, guest-cart adoption, PIN lockout, admin invites and HTTP resume, a closed 89-code permission registry, active role-assignment resolution, deny-by-default administration, consent/privacy seams, ownership checks, Account Security, and the admin idle soft-lock are implemented. The chunk remains partial until provider credentials and approved origins are configured, provider and PIN flows are proven in supported browsers, pending-intent continuation is implemented, and older privileged routes finish granular-permission adoption.
chunks.dod: Partial: the server and storefront identity/account paths are implemented. Complete provider activation and browser proof, PIN-login browser proof, pending-intent continuation, and granular-permission adoption.

chunks.title: Mongo persistence & transaction adoption
chunks.summary: Chunk E persistence is complete. The adapter exports 40 Mongoose models covering the original surface plus separated customer/operator identity, credentials, pending verification state, authorization, consent, catalogue structure, variants, bundles, relations, inventory, media, audit, notifications, FAQ, Q&A, reviews and rating aggregates. Atomic catalogue, inventory, governance and content workflows are rs0-proven.
chunks.dod: Complete: 100 adapter integration tests cover uniqueness, TTL, visibility, concurrency, transaction rollback, order-and-cart atomicity, role assignments and response-safe mapping.

chunks.title: Catalog, SEO, search & merchandising
chunks.summary: Catalog + SEO + self-hosted Meilisearch behind SearchPort + merchandising; live-only public reads; search outbox. Locale route seams are provisional until the URL policy is resolved.
chunks.dod: Public + admin catalog CRUD; Meili indexes live products only; search/facet tests.

chunks.title: Cart, checkout, orders & payment/shipping ports
chunks.summary: Cart and guest adoption, a pricing-engine shell (INR canonical, FX, PayPal gross-up), Payment/Shipping ports with non-production implementations, and order/payment/shipment/return/refund shapes with ownership, idempotency and transaction seams. Customer-facing order numbers wait on the numbering gate.
chunks.dod: Cart adoption, quote, non-production payment/shipping implementations and ownership tests; order placement remains internal-id-only or gated.

chunks.title: Inventory, purchase invoices, reporting & insights
chunks.summary: Inventory ledger + FIFO cost layers, analytics aggregates, insight/badge job seams, and purchase-invoice drafts. Posting PIs that assign numbers waits on the PI numbering gate.
chunks.dod: Ledger + aggregates; PI posting gated until the numbering lock.

chunks.title: Privacy, content, FAQ, reviews & media
chunks.summary: Consent + analytics gating, FAQ / Q&A / reviews, media assets + Spaces SGP presign, and an image-derivative job skeleton. Exact sharp sizes wait on the image-ladder gate.
chunks.dod: Consent gating; moderation model; media presign; derivative skeleton.

chunks.title: Docs, seeds, verification & infra close-out
chunks.summary: OpenAPI, runbook and environment docs aligned with §0b–0d, seeds and bulk fixtures, full lint/typecheck/test, and detailed deploy scripts.
chunks.dod: Docs aligned; seeds; green gates; deploy scripts documented; deferred seams reported.
